e2a2b7705dc8a3dc: SerikaCord is built for communities. To keep it a place where everyone can talk, hang out, and build together, we ask all users to follow these guidelines. Violations may result in content removal, warnings, or account termination depending on severity.
f5b5ab06a44ba6d4: Treat all users with basic respect. Do not harass, bully, threaten, or intimidate others — in public channels, DMs, or any other context on the platform. Targeted hate or discrimination based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or national origin is strictly prohibited.

456ec3020c5b71b8: Child sexual abuse material (CSAM) — zero tolerance, immediately reported to authorities
1152e9afe4a35bf2: Content that facilitates real-world violence or terrorism
9642556b6124ed23: Doxxing (sharing private personal information without consent)
37d168237c27ee4e: Pirated software, media, or copyrighted content distributed without authorisation
c4207de213582f6b: Do not send unsolicited bulk messages, run automated bots without server permission, or attempt to manipulate users through deceptive means. This includes phishing links, misleading invites, or artificially inflating server metrics.
a3769086caef9ef5: Explicit or adult content may only be shared in servers and channels explicitly designated for that purpose by server administrators, and only where permitted under local law. It must never be accessible to users under 18 or in general/unaged channels.

bfef9c243c8d3e59: Attempting unauthorised access to accounts or systems

1a54a02948557eea: Running API bots that abuse rate limits or bypass restrictions
dd96bf9d9d4572d0: Creating fake accounts or impersonating real users or staff
636913b3dd068ed6: Server owners and administrators are responsible for maintaining community standards within their servers. Servers that consistently host content violating these guidelines may be removed from the platform. Server owners must ensure appropriate moderation is in place, especially for large or public communities.
4353bbd14b9525d0: You may not impersonate Serika Company staff, other users, public figures, or any entity in a way that is deceptive or misleading. Parody accounts must be clearly labelled as such.
3edd944be028b308: Content that promotes, glorifies, or provides instruction for self-harm or suicide is not permitted. If you or someone you know is in crisis, please reach out to a local crisis line or emergency services.
1109db2dbde6b5a7: Serika Company reserves the right to remove content, issue warnings, restrict features, or permanently ban accounts that violate these guidelines. 05f44a6cc2e7a0dd: Discord is the biggest community chat app, with the most polish, an iPhone app and a huge bot ecosystem. SerikaCord is a much smaller, EU-based alternative with no ads, end-to-end encrypted DMs and a Discord-compatible bot API.
6dfdfcfc65a5c883: Stoat, formerly called Revolt, is a longer-running open-source alternative you can host yourself. SerikaCord is source-available rather than open source, and focuses on Discord-style features and moving communities over from Discord.
9ed7734d97a7ba0b: Choosing where your community lives is a big decision. These pages compare SerikaCord with the alternatives as honestly as we can: where they are better, where we are better, and what we haven't built yet.
5e673d6bc215cfa6: They are written by the SerikaCord team, so read them with that in mind and check the sources we link.
3397864e82289ff5: Facts about other apps come from their own websites, help centres, blogs and source code, or from reputable press. Every page lists its sources and the date we checked them.
d91acfc4dae49ca4: We say what we couldn't verify
d3ea610928fcd0f1: If we couldn't confirm something from a reliable source, we say so instead of guessing.
7af5359c4088f136: We include our own weak spots
f76a54436d4fc777: SerikaCord is young and run by a small team. Where another app is the better choice, we say it plainly.
f66e6f216d6a2533: Apps change quickly. If something here is wrong or out of date, email support@serika.dev and we'll fix it.

485621189af8b3bf: It's free, it runs in your browser, and there are apps for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. Bring your friends, or bridge your Discord server while you decide.
668159450407122d: Optional Nitro subscription (in the US: Nitro Basic $2.99 a month, Nitro $9.99 a month).
8648d1d1b90a22f7: Voice and video calls, screen sharing
d3d2360c102302dd: Calls connect directly between participants when possible (peer-to-peer), which suits smaller groups best.

3d85b5b39751c648: Launched October 2026, on by default for new conversations. Not independently audited yet.
75b514166699cb05: Discord says it has no current plans to bring end-to-end encryption to text messages.
acfc67ae0422ec98: DM and group DM calls only. Server voice channels are not end-to-end encrypted.
5fa00e00318dc3eb: DMs, group DMs, voice channels and Go Live streams, by default since March 2026. Stage channels are the exception.
75597ab19b7e9efd: Message content is encrypted when stored on our servers, but we can technically read it, so bots, search and moderation work.
ef805755b811b943: No ads and no advertising trackers, according to our Privacy Policy.
a86db57ae6c947b2: Sponsored Quests, including video Quests, and an Ads Manager for brands.
d807ebf18bd6b1e0: Modelled on Discord's API v10: many discord.js and discord.py bots can connect by changing the API address. Not everything Discord offers is covered.
2a64923db42005f3: The largest bot and app ecosystem by far.

1d706298f81a380f: In development. Until then, use the web app and add it to your Home Screen.

bc34cbfe6a45f689: Source-available: anyone can read it on GitHub, but the license is not open source and doesn't allow running your own copy without permission.
24b83eda8b215ac7: Discord says it has more than 200 million monthly active users. On SerikaCord you will probably have to invite people over, and there are far fewer public communities to discover. For most communities this matters more than any feature.
b565cc4024cbb934: Discord has been building its app since 2015 with a large team. SerikaCord is young and made by a small team: you will run into rough edges and bugs, and some things Discord has, like Stage channels, Activities and console apps, don't exist here yet.
31d6e513fe93f5bd: Discord has native apps on every major platform, including iOS. SerikaCord's iOS app is still in development, so iPhone users have to use the web app for now.
3f82cdf2851ef9ee: Thousands of established bots and apps are built for Discord. SerikaCord can run many Discord bots, but only if their owners point them at SerikaCord, and our API doesn't cover everything yet.
155b0119c115b851: Encrypted calls everywhere, not just in DMs
a70d8a06d3ffde27: Discord encrypts voice and video end to end in server voice channels and Go Live streams too. SerikaCord only does this for DM and group DM calls.
efa03aef4826fcdc: Discord runs very large servers and voice channels on its own global infrastructure. SerikaCord runs on a much smaller setup and hasn't been tested at that scale. Our calls connect peer-to-peer when possible, which means other people in a call can see your IP address, and large group video calls get heavy.
cfb4628de150a459: SerikaCord doesn't show ads, doesn't use advertising trackers and doesn't sell your data. Discord shows sponsored Quests and is expanding its advertising business.
437ee37d79a8e287: DMs and group DMs, including their text, files and calls, are end-to-end encrypted by default for new conversations, with safety numbers to check who you're talking to and a recovery passphrase for new devices. Discord encrypts calls but not text. Our encryption is new (October 2026) and hasn't been independently audited yet.
499cc63bed5d4d99: SerikaCord is run by Serika Company in the Netherlands, under the GDPR and Dutch law, and you can complain to the Dutch data protection authority. Discord is a US company headquartered in San Francisco, with an EU entity in the Netherlands.
33c34438eaf26b97: SerikaCord asks for your date of birth and requires you to be 16 or older. It doesn't ask for ID documents or selfies. Discord now sorts accounts into adults and teens and may ask some people to prove their age, for example with a selfie or ID. In October 2025 Discord reported that a customer-service provider was breached, possibly exposing about 70,000 users' ID photos from age appeals.
54cf36ad80d3558d: Familiar, and it works with your Discord bots
5ed51128a0e2ffea: SerikaCord deliberately works like Discord, so there's little to learn. Its bot API follows Discord's, and a consent-based bridge can mirror messages between a Discord server and a SerikaCord server while your community moves at its own pace.
dd4d1d15354bb937: Bigger free uploads and readable code

540617b11b412f63.c: Each section is judged on what a normal person or community gets today, not on roadmaps. S means best in class, A excellent, B good, C mixed, D weak, and F missing or unusable. A tier can be empty. Inside a tier, apps are listed from best to worst.

Facts come from each app's own website, documentation, source code, app store listings and policies, plus reputable press and security research. Where we couldn't verify something, we didn't count it. Every comparison page lists its sources with dates.

Matrix and XMPP are ranked as networks with their best-known apps (Element and Movim). Kloak shut down in October 2026, so it is F everywhere; its page records what it offered. Things change quickly, so treat this as a snapshot.

574b3649f0454628: Commet is a free, open-source app (a client) for Matrix, the open, federated chat network. You sign in with an account on any Matrix homeserver, and Commet shows your spaces and rooms in a Discord-like layout with voice rooms, calendar and photo album rooms, and several accounts logged in at once. 88668ea6b5fa8e5e: Much of what people say about Matrix is really about one server or one app. These are the three layers:
029bd6edb2340563: The protocol: Matrix itself is an open standard kept by the Matrix.org Foundation, a UK nonprofit. Anyone can build servers and apps for it.
f9660340a3c566c4: The homeserver: your account lives on a server you choose. matrix.org is the largest public one, and its rules (18+, verified email, 10 MB free uploads) don't apply on other servers or on your own.
a7213c4394170694: The app: Element is the main client, made by the company Element, which now focuses on governments and businesses. Element X is its newer mobile app and Element Classic the older one. Other clients, including the Discord-style Sable and Commet, work with the same account.
226627b865b86f63: Unless a cell says otherwise, this page describes Matrix as most people meet it: Element on the matrix.org homeserver.

It doesn't run the network itself: you pick a Matrix homeserver such as matrix.org or sable.moe, and Sable gives you a Discord-like look with spaces, voice rooms, polls and themes on top.
